decision: No source-review blocker for the frozen current39d contribution. Independent receiving and ordinary repository merge gates remain separate.
review: Read the complete new 183-line pure module, complete consumer guide and all four additive API/CLI/MCP/catalog seams. Raw get_discussion still supplies the report through its existing two-GET operation; no posting, read marking, ratings, subscriptions, transport or session code is introduced.

Preorder traversal retains occurrence paths, original parent IDs and entry fields. Deleted bodies and authors are not invented. Participant attribution requires one exact ID match. Missing or repeated identity associations remain explicit; unread filtering retains necessary ancestors and refuses a repeated unread ID association.

Missing/null unread metadata is distinguished from an explicit empty list. The full report keeps unknown states; unread selection errors when its metadata is unavailable. Unmatched identifiers remain inspectable beside observed/returned counts.

The report copies source topic, row fields and view metadata. Structural positions are explicitly scoped to one returned cached view. A separate new-entry stream, if supplied as metadata, is retained without being silently merged into the tree.

Positive numeric route IDs and an actual boolean are validated before the raw API call. MCP uses StrictBool and read-only annotations. CLI catches the established API/HTTP/value failures into nonzero stderr diagnostics; it emits a success report only after complete report construction.

The current39d composition preserves the separately owned self-submission source. The manifest reports exact retained owner function ASTs and byte-preserved client/session/broker/dependencies/tests; actual runtime validation belongs to the separately pinned author and receiver records.

primary_api_contract.retrieval: Root directly opened the official current documentation and retrieved the full-topic definition.
primary_api_contract.supported_facts: The view endpoint returns a cached threaded body plus participants and unread/forced ID lists. An ID absent from a supplied unread list is read. A required initial post can cause403, and an unavailable cache can cause503. Read marking is a separate endpoint.
primary_api_contract.application: The report exposes cached/unknown boundaries and existing errors without making a live-school access or cache-freshness guarantee.

qualification_boundary.author_current39d_report: 658 pytest cases passed,45 subtests passed,one explicit Chromium skip; Ruff passed; exact receipt and sources remain in author evidence.
qualification_boundary.independent_receiving: Production is receiving the frozen source separately; this record is not its result.
